title: Claims and Payouts under CareShield Life
what_it_is: Claims and Payouts under CareShield Life

sections.label: CareShield premiums and ADL payouts
sections.summary: The scheme targets severe disability to keep premiums affordable; covering one or two ADLs would raise premiums, and the Ministry will consider this in designing CareShield premiums.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To keep the scheme sustainable and premiums affordable for all, it is targeted at severe disability, given that the needs and costs for caring someone with severe disability are most significant.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Should the scheme be expanded to cover mild to moderate disabilities, premiums will be significantly higher and affordability will be affected.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Allowing policyholders to receive payouts, whether full or partial, once they are unable to perform one ADL will result in higher premiums.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To illustrate, if policyholders are able to receive payouts once they are unable to perform two ADLs, premiums will need to increase by about one-third.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Reducing the payouts by two-thirds at one ADL will not fully offset the premium increase required to cover the individuals who are unable to perform one ADL, as there will still be more claimants overall.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Singaporeans who wish to have better coverage, including making a claim when they are unable to perform two ADLs, can consider purchasing Supplement policies from the private insurers, which are currently already available under the existing ElderShield.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Is it possible that Ministry will consider to give it as an option to all Singaporeans to consider, even though it is lower payout or higher premium, for one ADL, rather than wait for the three to be fulfilled?

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: This will be taken into account when designing the CareShield premiums.
